children: a decline in its estimated book value per common share to $7.74 as of August 31 from $7.75 as of July 31.
Unrestricted cash and unencumbered investments reduced to $534.7M from $549.3M.

Investment portfolio as of August end reached $8.3B from $8.1B at the end of the prior month. The portfolio consisted of 30-year fixed-rate pass-through comprising 80.3% of agency RMBS, agency CMO 0.7%, and agency CMBS 10.8%. Total agency to-be-announced comprised 8.2%.
Repurchase agreement borrowings increased to $6.9B from $6.5B.
Debt-to-equity ratio stood at 6.8x on August 31, while the economic debt-to-equity ratio was 7.5x.
The mortgage REIT maintained its monthly cash dividend at $0.12 per share, payable on October 15 to stockholders of record at the close of business on September 28.

title: Invesco Mortgage Capital sees decline in August-end estimated book value per share
